chain_trace.break_detail: The claim 'legal cluster operation wrongly rejected with status 400' rests on the request being a valid cluster operation. It was not: {"operation": "create_sharding_key", "shard_key": ...} matches no variant of the documented ClusterOperations oneOf (documentation example '{"abort_resharding": {}}'; OpenAPI CreateShardingKeyOperation = {"create_sharding_key": {"shard_key": ...}}; Rust #[serde(untagged)] enum at lib/collection/src/operations/cluster_ops.rs:15). The 400 'Format error in JSON body' is correct, documented validation behavior - not an illegal rejection. Independently, even schema-correct bodies cannot reach 200 on this deployment: src/common/collections.rs:260-264 returns 400 'Distributed mode disabled' when consensus_state is None (standalone container, corroborated by boundary_007/008 whose correct-form requests received exactly that), so the 200-acceptance face was unexercisable in this environment for any request. Sibling scripts hitting the identical response (semantic_002/006) honestly exited SCRIPT_ERROR and deferred the rejection claim to this script, which then misadjudicated it.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: actix route update_collection_cluster (src/actix/api/collections_api.rs:215) declares parameter `operation: Json<ClusterOperations>` - actix-web deserializes the request body into the #[serde(untagged)] enum ClusterOperations (lib/collection/src/operations/cluster_ops.rs:14-54) BEFORE the handler body runs; a body matching no variant fails extraction and surfaces as HTTP 400 'Format error in JSON body: data did not match any variant of untagged enum ClusterOperations' - character-for-character the observed raw response. Each variant struct is a single-key wrapper (CreateShardingKeyOperation{create_sharding_key: CreateShardingKey}), so {'operation': ..., 'shard_key': ...} can never match. If deserialization succeeds, do_update_collection_cluster (src/common/collections.rs:247) returns 400 'Distributed mode disabled' when dispatcher.consensus_state() is None (this standalone deployment) before executing anything - exactly what boundary_007/008 observed with correct-form bodies. The dedicated v1.18 shard-key endpoints (src/actix/api/shards_api.rs:52,82 - PUT create / POST delete shard key) funnel into the same do_update_collection_cluster and thus the same gate. No validation gap exists: the untagged-enum shape IS the validation the assertion's 'valid operation' domain presupposes, and it worked as documented.
